The per-rep purchase-order report now leaves out cancelled purchase orders. The tests matching `*PurchaseOrder*` passed. I didn't add a test for your Anna/Bob example or run the full suite.

The fix is in `findPurchaseOrderCountPerSalesRep` in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java`. The count subquery now has `po.status <> 'CANCELLED'`, the same filter the other counts use. I also added a line to the method's Javadoc saying cancelled orders are excluded. Reps with no purchase orders still show 0, and the ordering is unchanged.

I haven't committed anything.
